title: Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance
statementMd:
Colin is a huge fan of the Kingdom Rush franchise tower defense games. Last year, KR released the latest generation of Kingdom Rush: *Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance*. As a formidable evil arises in the new generation, an unexpected alliance is taking shape! It will take the finest warriors of Linirea and the relentless Dark Army together to stop it. Therefore, the most attractive feature of the latest generation of games is that you can use two heroes simultaneously!

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3a34b5cf9d7ca0b9e410468e80296b5bff60f09c.png)

To measure the power of the double-hero feature, Colin would like to do some simple experiments: Assume that a hero's attack range is a circle on the 2D plane with its coordinates as the center. The path of enemies is a segment on the 2D plane. Colin would like to ask you how long the total length of the enemy's path is that is covered by at least one hero's attack range?

## Input

The first line contains three integers $x_1,y_1,r_1\ (|x_1|,|y_1|\le 10^9, 1\le r_1\le 10^9)$, representing the coordinates of the first hero as $(x_1,y_1)$, and the radius of its attack range is $r_1$.

The second line contains three integers $x_2,y_2,r_2\ (|x_2|,|y_2|\le 10^9, 1\le r_2\le 10^9)$, representing the coordinates of the second hero as $(x_2,y_2)$, and the radius of its attack range is $r_2$.

The third line contains four integers $a,b,c,d~(|a|,|b|,|c|,|d|\le 10^9)$, representing the path of enemies as a segment from $(a,b)$ to $(c,d)$.

## Output

A single line with a number, representing the total length of the enemy's path that is covered by at least one hero's attack range.

Your output will be considered correct if the absolute or relative error to the jury does not exceed $10^{-6}$.
statementZhMd:
Colin 是《王国保卫战》系列塔防游戏的忠实粉丝。去年，KR 推出了《王国保卫战》系列的最新一代作品：*王国保卫战 5：联盟*。在新一代作品中，一股强大的邪恶势力崛起，一个意想不到的联盟正在形成！利尼雷亚最精锐的战士必须与冷酷无情的黑暗军团联手，才能阻止这股势力。因此，这一代游戏最吸引人的特色就是可以同时使用两名英雄！

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3a34b5cf9d7ca0b9e410468e80296b5bff60f09c.png)

为了衡量双英雄机制的威力，Colin 想做一些简单的实验：假设一名英雄的攻击范围是二维平面上以其所在位置为圆心的圆形区域。敌人的行进路径是二维平面上的一条线段。Colin 想请你求出，敌人路径上被至少一名英雄的攻击范围覆盖的部分的总长度是多少？

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个整数 $x_1,y_1,r_1\ (|x_1|,|y_1|\le 10^9, 1\le r_1\le 10^9)$，表示第一名英雄的坐标为 $(x_1,y_1)$，攻击范围的半径为 $r_1$。

第二行包含三个整数 $x_2,y_2,r_2\ (|x_2|,|y_2|\le 10^9, 1\le r_2\le 10^9)$，表示第二名英雄的坐标为 $(x_2,y_2)$，攻击范围的半径为 $r_2$。

第三行包含四个整数 $a,b,c,d~(|a|,|b|,|c|,|d|\le 10^9)$，表示敌人的行进路径是从 $(a,b)$ 到 $(c,d)$ 的线段。

## 输出格式

输出一行，包含一个数，表示敌人路径上被至少一名英雄的攻击范围覆盖的部分的总长度。

如果你的输出与标准答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{-6}$，则会被判定为正确。
